slides.title: Welcome to HTML5
slides.content:
# HTML5 New Features 🚀

HTML5 represents the largest evolution of the web platform, bringing semantic structural elements, native multimedia playback, graphics APIs, and web storage.

## What you'll master:
- 🏛️ **Semantic Structural Tags** - `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<article>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`
- 🎯 **Interactive Content Semantics** - `<details>`, `<summary>`, `<figure>`, `<time>`, `<dialog>`
- 🎵 **Native Audio & Video** - Embedding media without external plugins
- 🎨 **HTML5 Canvas 2D API** - Dynamic scriptable graphics and game rendering
- ⚡ **Modern Web Standards** - SVG vs Canvas comparison and modern browser APIs

slides.title: HTML5 Audio Embedding
slides.content:
# Native Audio with `<audio>` 🎵

Before HTML5, playing audio required third-party plugins like Adobe Flash. HTML5 provides standard native playback.

```html_not
<audio controls preload="metadata">
  <source src="podcast.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  <source src="podcast.ogg" type="audio/ogg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>
```

## Essential Attributes:
- `controls`: Displays play/pause, volume, and progress bar controls.
- `autoplay`: Starts playback automatically (usually blocked by browsers unless muted).
- `loop`: Loops the audio continuously.
- `muted`: Starts audio in a muted state.
- `preload`: Advises browser on loading strategy (`none`, `metadata`, `auto`).

slides.title: HTML5 Video Embedding
slides.content:
# Native Video with `<video>` 🎬

Embedding responsive video directly into the webpage:

```html_not
<video width="640" height="360" controls poster="cover.jpg">
  <source src="movie.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <source src="movie.webm" type="video/webm">
  <track src="subtitles_en.vtt" kind="subtitles" srclang="en" label="English">
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>
```

## Key Attributes:
- `poster`: Image displayed while the video downloads or until user presses play.
- `<track>`: Adds timed text subtitles or captions in `.vtt` (WebVTT) format.
- `playsinline`: Plays inside page instead of forcing fullscreen on mobile iOS devices.

slides.title: Introduction to HTML5 Canvas
slides.content:
# Introduction to HTML5 Canvas 🎨

The `<canvas>` element provides a resolution-dependent bitmap canvas that can be drawn on dynamically using JavaScript.

```html_not
<canvas id="myCanvas" width="400" height="200" style="border:1px solid #ccc;">
  Fallback text for browsers without canvas support.
</canvas>
```

## How Canvas Works:
1. `<canvas>` itself is purely a blank graphic container.
2. JavaScript must be used to get the rendering context and execute drawing commands.
3. Perfect for charts, photo manipulation, data visualizations, and 2D games!

SVG vs Canvas: When to Use Which
slides.content:
# SVG vs Canvas: Architectural Comparison ⚖️

Both technologies create graphics in HTML5, but their architectures differ completely:

| Feature | HTML5 Canvas | Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Technology** | Raster (Pixel-based bitmap) | Vector (XML DOM nodes) |
| **Scalability** | Pixelates when zoomed | Infinitely scalable without quality loss |
| **Event Handling** | No DOM nodes (manual collision) | Full DOM events (clicks on shapes) |
| **CSS Styling** | Cannot be styled with CSS | Fully stylable with CSS |
| **Performance** | High performance for 1000s of objects | Performance drops with high object count |
| **Best For** | 2D Games, charts, image processing | Icons, logos, UI illustrations |

slides.title: Modern Web Storage APIs
slides.content:
# Web Storage & Browser APIs 💾 HTML5 introduced client-side storage mechanisms far superior to legacy cookies: 1. **`localStorage`**: Stores key-value data with no expiration time (persists after browser restarts). 2. **`sessionStorage`**: Stores data for the duration of the browser tab session (cleared on tab close). 3. **Geolocation API**: Allows web apps to access geographical coordinates with user permission. 4. **Drag and Drop API**: Native dragging of elements with `draggable="true"`. ```html_not
Drag me!
```

slides.title: Summary & Next Steps
slides.content:
# HTML5 Mastery Achieved! 🏆

You have conquered HTML5's most powerful capabilities!

## Key Takeaways:
- ✅ **Semantics:** `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<article>`, `<section>`, `<footer>` replace generic divs.
- ✅ **Self-Contained Content:** Use `<article>` for independent entities, `<section>` for chapters.
- ✅ **Native Media:** `<audio>` and `<video>` with `<track>` subtitles.
- ✅ **Canvas 2D:** High-performance pixel rendering via JavaScript context.
- ✅ **SVG vs Canvas:** Vector DOM shapes (SVG) vs high-speed raster pixels (Canvas).
